prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The new policy aims to _____ the gap between rich and poor.

wrong.narrate: narrate 是敘述，與 gap（差距）搭配不通。
wrong.nourish: nourish 是滋養，不能用來形容縮小差距。

why: narrow the gap 是「縮小差距」的常見搭配，與 aims to 語意相合。
say: The new policy aims to narrow the gap between rich and poor.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The sudden storm _____ the football match for an hour.

wrong.imposed: impose 是強加，不能與 match 搭配表示延期。
wrong.exposed: expose 是暴露，不符合比賽被延後的語意。

why: postpone 是延期，暴風雨造成比賽延後一小時，語意正確。
tip: postpone = 延期，impose = 強加，別混淆。
say: The sudden storm postponed the football match for an hour.

prompt: 哪一句的詞彙搭配最自然？
options: She made a great effort to finish the report.
She did a great effort to finish the report.
She took a great effort to finish the report.
answer: She made a great effort to finish the report.

wrong.She did a great effort to finish the rep: effort 常和 make 搭配，make an effort，不用 do。
wrong.She took a great effort to finish the re: take 要搭配 time 等，effort 的固定搭配是 make an effort。

why: make an effort 是固定搭配，意為努力。
tip: make an effort，不是 do an effort。
say: She made a great effort to finish the report.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Residents were _____ to boil the water before drinking it.

wrong.adapted: adapt 是適應，不能接 to boil 表示建議。
wrong.admired: admire 是欣賞，與被要求做某事的語意不合。

why: be advised to + 原形 表示被建議去做某事，常用於公告。
tip: be advised to V：被建議要…
say: Residents were advised to boil the water before drinking it.

prompt: 下面的 turn out 是什麼意思？
text: The plan turned out to be far more expensive than expected.

wrong.轉彎: turn 的本義是轉彎，但 turn out to be 是固定片語，表示結果。
wrong.關掉: turn off 才是關掉；turn out 在這裡表示最後發現。

why: turn out to be 表示「結果是；最後證明是」，後面的 expensive 說明事實。
say: The plan turned out to be far more expensive than expected.

prompt: 文意選擇：選出最適合的連接詞。
text: Tom practiced every day. _____, he won first place in the contest.

wrong.In contrast: In contrast 表示對比，但前後是努力與成功的因果關係。
wrong.Otherwise: Otherwise 是「否則」，用來引出不照做的後果，不是這裡的結果。

why: 每天練習導致第一名，後句是前句的結果，用 As a result。
tip: 看前後句關係：因果、對比或補充。
say: Tom practiced every day. As a result, he won first place in the contest.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The company is _____ for its excellent customer service.

wrong.reminded: remind 是提醒，be reminded for 不通順，也不是稱讚的語意。
wrong.reduced: reduce 是減少，與被稱讚服務優良的語意不合。

why: be renowned for 表示因…而聞名，後面接優點。
say: The company is renowned for its excellent customer service.

prompt: 哪一句的介系詞搭配正確？
options: The success of the project depends on teamwork.
The success of the project depends of teamwork.
The success of the project depends in teamwork.
answer: The success of the project depends on teamwork.

wrong.The success of the project depends of te: depend 固定搭配 on，不是 of。
wrong.The success of the project depends in te: depend 後面用 on 表示依靠，不用 in。

why: depend on 是固定搭配，表示取決於。
say: The success of the project depends on teamwork.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Strict rules help _____ cheating during exams.

wrong.present: present 是呈現或贈送，無法與 cheating 構成「防止」的語意。
wrong.pretend: pretend 是假裝，help pretend cheating 邏輯不通。

why: prevent 是防止，嚴格規則的目的是防止作弊。
say: Strict rules help prevent cheating during exams.

prompt: 餐廳經理想委婉地說：「很抱歉造成您的不便。」
options: We are apologizing of the inconvenience.

apologize to 後面接人，為某事道歉要用 for。
apologize 後的介系詞是 for，不是 of，且現在進行式不自然。

why: apologize for + 事情，apologize to + 人。

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The museum offers free admission, which _____ more visitors.

wrong.distracts: distract 是使分心，不符合免費入場吸引人的語意。
wrong.subtracts: subtract 是減去，用在數學，不能與 visitors 這樣搭配。

why: attract 是吸引，免費入場自然吸引更多遊客。
say: The museum offers free admission, which attracts more visitors.

prompt: in spite of 的意思是什麼？
text: In spite of the noise, she kept reading.

wrong.因為噪音: because of 才是因為，in spite of 是讓步。
wrong.除了噪音之外: besides／except 才有除外或此外的意思。

why: in spite of = despite，表示儘管，後面接名詞或動名詞。
tip: in spite of = despite = 儘管。
say: In spite of the noise, she kept reading.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The teacher asked us to _____ our answers carefully before handing in the test.

wrong.reveal: reveal 是揭露，不適合描述交卷前檢查答案。
wrong.rescue: rescue 是拯救，與檢查答案毫無關係。

why: review 有複查、複習的意思，交卷前仔細檢查最合理。
tip: 交卷前 review，別只是 reveal。
say: The teacher asked us to review our answers carefully before handing in the test.

prompt: 哪一句完成時態使用正確？

since 表示從過去持續到現在，要搭配現在完成式。
since 搭配現在完成式，不用現在進行式。

why: since + 過去時間點，主要子句用現在完成式。

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: His speech was so _____ that the audience stood up and clapped.

wrong.inspired: inspired 是被激勵的，用來形容人；speech 是令人振奮的，要用 inspiring。
wrong.inspire: inspire 是動詞，so 後面需要形容詞。

why: speech 是造成感受的事物，用 -ing 形容詞 inspiring。
tip: 物用 V-ing，人感受用 V-ed。
say: His speech was so inspiring that the audience stood up and clapped.
